headline: Export is always reachable, and the delivery says which language it is.
highlights: An Export button sits in the toolbar as well as the sidebar, so it cannot fall below the fold on a short window.
The summary opens with the target language in large type, with the source and the script beside it.
Export could not be opened at all until audio had been imported — the button was greyed and the menu item with it, with nothing to say why.
